group: Padmanabh Mafatlal group (Arvind Mafatlal family); promoter vehicle Mafatlal Impex Pvt Ltd
basis: Consolidated (Screener consolidated page; subsidiaries Navin Fluorine Advanced Sciences Ltd (NFASL, Dahej), Manchester Organics (UK), NFIL USA). Company reports one operating segment ('Chemical Business').

description: India's largest integrated specialty fluorochemicals company and one of the first refrigerant makers in India (since 1967, 'Mafron' brand). Three verticals: High Performance Products (HPP: refrigerant gases R22/R32, HFO made for Honeywell, anhydrous and diluted hydrofluoric acid, inorganic fluorides such as BF3); Specialty Chemicals (fluorinated intermediates for agrochemical and pharma innovators, mostly multi-year contracts and campaigns run in multi-purpose plants); and CDMO (contract development and manufacturing for pharma under the Navin Molecular brand, mainly late-stage and commercial intermediates). It is incubating a fourth vertical, Advanced Materials (data-centre cooling fluids, electronic-grade HF, semiconductor and defence materials). Plants at Surat (Bhestan), Dahej (via NFASL), Dewas (CDMO cGMP plants) and a lab at Runcorn, UK. 66% of FY26 revenue came from outside India (USA ₹761 cr).

customerConcentration.fy26: Three customers each ≥10% of revenue: ₹545.03 cr, ₹390.61 cr and ₹341.72 cr (together 38.5% of revenue).

callHighlights: Operating cash flow ₹173 cr in Q1; 'Navin also became net debt free during the quarter'; net working capital 81 days of sales.

Margin outlook: 'in the range of that 32%, 33%, plus/minus 1%' over the next one to two years, helped by the new HFC plant, MPP debottleneck and Chemours (CFO). In April the CFO had said 'we will endeavor to do 30%... plus/minus 1% to 2%' for FY27.
Gross margin fell ~100bp QoQ on raw-material inflation linked to 'heightened global war tensions'; offset by fixed-cost productivity.

R32: current capacity 9,000-10,000 t; adding 15,000 t (₹236.5 cr) in Q3FY27; 'a couple of contracts' signed, aiming for 35-45% of capacity under five-year contracts; India 'going to be oversupplied for five years' so exports matter; the ₹600-825 cr peak revenue shown for the new plant is the board 'downside case' (Apr-2026 call); China R32 ~US$9/kg (Apr-2026 call).

CDMO: US$100 mn FY27 target 'very much on track'; cGMP4 (₹288 cr approved Feb-2024) to reach ~3x asset turn by FY29; phase 2 (₹125 cr) started, ready Q4FY27; moving to API-minus-1 for the European partner; 30-40 molecules in work, ~10 late stage, 3-4 FDA read-outs in 8-12 months; one read-out 'didn't come quite well'.

Specialty: 13-14 new molecules in FY26; FY27 campaign orders for 4-5 agro molecules, three patented; 'pricing pressure continues', especially LatAm; will not return to the 'old days of 30% EBITDA' in spec chem.

Advanced materials: ₹90 cr adoption plant at Surat (completion Q2FY28); 4-5 products lab-approved, ~a dozen in the basket; Chemours project ₹120 cr (35% customer funded) targeted end-Q2FY27 (slipped from Q1FY27); DRDO technology-development project (sodium borohydride, per ICICI Securities); aim: a business the size of today's CDMO by the end of the decade.
Honeywell HFO plant commercialised Jul-2022; original term seven years with a three-year extension at Honeywell's option.
AHF: 60,000 t between Surat and Dahej 'good enough for the next four to five years'; interim external AHF sales until downstream capacity comes up.
